siux-electra-pro-st4-2025: Light and quick, with easy power for the price. The sweet spot runs small.
nox-at10-18k-2025: Soft and forgiving with a big sweet spot. Smashes need extra effort, and the face gets bouncy in heat.
adidas-metalbone-ctrl-2026: Big, forgiving sweet spot with easy power. The springy face can feel too lively at the net.
nox-at10-genius-12k-alum-xtrem-2026: Firm and crisp, quick in the hands, with a forgiving sweet spot. The stiffness splits opinions.
nox-at10-genius-12k-2025: Dry, direct and controlled, and gentle on the arm. The power has to come from you.
bullpadel-vertex-05-hybrid-2026: Large, forgiving sweet spot and a dry touch with little bounce. Smashes take more effort.
babolat-counter-viper-2025: Crisp, dry control for players with healthy arms. Head-heavy, and very hard in the cold.
oxdog-ultimate-tour-x-2026: A light, controlled diamond that's easy on the arm. Trades some top-end power for placement.
nox-at10-genius-18k-2026: Soft, comfortable and forgiving. Modest power, and the face can run away at pace.
siux-fenix-pro-6-2026: Easy power and big smashes. The head-heavy balance makes defence hard work.
babolat-air-viper-2025: Fast and sharp at the net with a stiff, dry feel. The small sweet spot punishes off-centre hits.
adidas-metalbone-3-4-2025: Free power on smashes for strong attackers. Slower to move and defend with.
adidas-metalbone-ctrl-3-4-2025: Huge, forgiving sweet spot and a soft feel for defenders. Blocks and fast volleys can fly long.
head-extreme-motion-2025: A diamond that handles like a rounder shape, with easy power on overheads and a dry feel.
oxdog-hyper-pro-2-0-2026: Firm, dry and controlled, with little vibration. Most owners tune the weight and balance.
siux-diablo-pro-2026: Light and firm with very little bounce. Good control, though some want more power.
adidas-metalbone-hrd-plus-3-4-2025: Easy attacking power for strong players. Stiff, and hard to control on blocks.
siux-diablo-pro-4-2025: Big, forgiving sweet spot and quick hands in defence. The glossy paint scratches easily.
adidas-metalbone-carbon-ctrl-3-4-2025: Forgiving, controlled and easy on the arm. Modest power, and blocks can go long.
siux-fenix-pro-5-2025: Big smash power with a firm, dry feel. Heavy and demanding in defence.
bullpadel-vertex-04-2024: Precise and quick at the net for some, unpredictable for others. Less smash power than hoped.
bullpadel-hack-04-hybrid-2025: Dry and firm with little trampoline, and easy to handle. A good mix of control and power.
head-coello-motion-2026: Forgiving for a diamond, easy to move and comfortable. Power is decent, not extreme.
oxdog-ultimate-pro-plus-2025: Strong ball exit and solid control for stronger players. The weight tires some in long matches.
kuikma-hybrid-pro-2026: Medium-hard, dry and easy to move, with good control. Plays above its price.
nox-ea10-ventus-hybrid-12k-2026: Dry and firm with no trampoline, and quick at the net. The sweet spot is a little smaller.
nox-at10-genius-12k-alum-xtrem-lite-2026: Very light, comfortable and quick at the net. Limited power on overheads.
bullpadel-neuron-02-2026: Precise placement and light handling for control players. Not one for big smashes.
bullpadel-vertex-04-2025: Lots of smash power for attackers. A smaller sweet spot and extra weight to manage.
bullpadel-hack-04-hybrid-2026: Strong control and defence with a firm, dry feel. The foam splits opinions.
wilson-bela-v3-2026: Rough face for spin and weight for smashing. The smaller sweet spot punishes poor contact.
adidas-metalbone-hrd-plus-3-5-2026: Serious ball speed and smash power. Demanding, with a small sweet spot and high balance.
bullpadel-neuron-2025: Light, manoeuvrable and controlled, with a big sweet spot. Overheads lack punch.
babolat-air-viper-2026: Quick and crisp at the net. A bit more forgiving than the 2025, but it still asks for technique.
siux-pegasus-pro-2026: Easy to move, with good power and a gentle feel on the arm. Durability is the big question mark.
bullpadel-vertex-05-geo-2026: Easy, explosive power for attackers with the technique to steer it. Can feel head-heavy.
bullpadel-vertex-04-hybrid-2025: Control and comfort, with a sweet spot most find generous. Power is only moderate.
siux-electra-pro-st5-2026: Light and punchy at the net. The small sweet spot splits opinions.
bullpadel-neuron-02-edge-2026: Firm, dry control for advanced players. Off-centre hits go dead.
bullpadel-vertex-05-2026: A dry, comfortable all-rounder that's kind to the arm. A bit short on power for big hitters.
oxdog-ultimate-pro-light-2026: Very light and quick at the net. The small sweet spot asks for good technique.
adidas-metalbone-3-5-2026: Plenty of easy power on smashes and volleys. The heavy head slows you down in defence.
head-coello-motion-2025: Power and control for confident attackers. Head-heavy, which costs some defence.
babolat-technical-viper-2025: Hard, dry and heavy, with real smash power. Rewards good technique and forgives very little.
babolat-viper-soft-juan-lebron-3-0-2026: Big power on overheads and volleys, and firmer than the name suggests.
adidas-metalbone-carbon-ctrl-3-5-2026: Firm, stable control and good manoeuvrability. A little short on power and dead on blocks.
babolat-counter-viper-2026: Light, dry and precise. The very firm feel can leave it short on power.
